Title: Clan Imper. and Justicars question for Shawn

Messages.Author: Marc Nuessen
Messages.Body:
Does Clan Imp. do anything to the vampires voting status if they were
say a justicar. for example Aneke impersonates a Nosferatu is she
still Toreador justicar or is she a contestable nosferatu justicar or
does she lose the title or what?

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
m...@ksu.ksu.edu (Marc Nuessen) writes:



She remains the Toreador Justicar, even though she is now Nosferatu.

Same as if she had a Tor-Only card (like Aching Beauty) on her. It
continues to apply even when she is Toreador no longer.
